task.title: Accept authenticated comment-only review summaries
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/729 by recognizing authenticated CodeRabbit no-finding summaries exposed only as generated issue comments while retaining exact-head and anti-spoofing checks.
acceptance_criteria: Accept a substantive authenticated CodeRabbit generated summary when no qualifying pull-request review object exists.
Keep exact-head commit-range checks and authenticated bot authorship mandatory.
Continue rejecting rate-limited, paused, failed, contradictory, stale, or spoofed evidence.
Cover the regression through the offline merge-readiness test suite.

attempts.summary: Reproduced the comment-only summary false negative.
attempts.diagnostic: The substantive-review predicate examined only pull-request review objects, so a genuine authenticated no-finding summary exposed only as an issue comment remained BLOCKED.
attempts.patch: Added a regression fixture with no qualifying review object and an authenticated generated summary comment containing exact-head no-actionable-findings evidence.

attempts.diagnostic: A generated summary comment can establish substantive exact-head coverage when CodeRabbit publishes no corresponding pull-request review object.
attempts.patch: Reused the authenticated exact-head summary predicate for substantive evidence while retaining commit-range binding, contradiction checks, and every fail-closed rate-limit rule.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review and hosted checks found no scope expansion beyond the observed CodeRabbit response shape.
attempts.patch: Kept the fix to a small verifier predicate and one focused regression case.

outcome.summary: The exact-head readiness verifier now accepts genuine authenticated comment-only no-finding summaries without weakening rate-limit, stale-head, spoofing, or unresolved-thread defenses.

lessons: External review systems may expose a completed no-finding review only as a substantive authenticated generated summary comment.
Evidence correlation should tolerate an absent review object without relaxing identity or exact-head requirements.
A focused real-shape regression is safer than broadening acceptance heuristics.
Contradictory rate-limit or failure text must continue to override positive summary phrases.
